name: Snackible Dipsters
ingredients_raw: Biscuit Sticks: Whole wheat flour, refined wheat flour, jaggery, edible vegetable oil (sunflower oil), sodium bicarbonate, ammonium bicarbonate, lecithin, salt. Chocolatey Dip: Edible vegetable oil (sunflower oil), jaggery, milk solids, maltodextrin (INS1400), cocoa solids, edible vegetable fat-(hydrogenated). emulsifier (INS322(i)- lecithin of soya origin) CONTAINS ADDED NATURE IDENTICAL (VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES.
